skill.name: sheetfolk-budget-builder
skill.description: Create a local Excel workbook for a monthly budget, sinking funds, or side-hustle income and expenses. Use when asked to build a budget spreadsheet, plan recurring costs, track savings goals, or organize small business cash flow.
skill.summary: Build a local Excel budget workbook with planned amounts, actual amounts, formulas, and optional sinking fund or side hustle categories.
skill.author: melmayssonowen

content.value_statement: Planning expenses is harder when budget amounts are scattered across notes. This skill creates a local Excel workbook with planned amounts, actual amounts, and formulas.
actual_capabilities: Create an XLSX workbook using only the Python standard library.
Include Budget and READ ME tabs with blue input cells.
Generate monthly, sinking fund, side hustle, or combined category sets.
Add planned minus actual formulas and column totals.
Accept a custom month label and output path through command line options.
Create missing output directories and write the workbook locally.
limitations: Amounts require manual entry; there are no bank imports, account connections, or transaction feeds.
Income and expenses share column totals; these totals do not calculate net cash flow.
Savings targets, forecasts, and tax calculations are not automated; a spreadsheet application must calculate the formulas.
Existing output files are overwritten without confirmation; the workbook is an organizational aid, not financial advice.

use_cases.title: Plan Household Spending
use_cases.description: Create a monthly worksheet to compare planned and actual amounts across housing, food, utilities, and other household categories.

use_cases.title: Organize Irregular Expenses
use_cases.description: Add sinking fund rows for annual bills and repairs, then enter monthly contributions manually.

use_cases.title: Separate Side Hustle Categories
use_cases.description: Add side hustle income and expense rows alongside standard budget categories without connecting financial accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Monthly Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a monthly budget workbook for [month] at [new output path]. Keep input amounts at zero and identify the editable cells.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a basic household workbook.

prompt_templates.title: Add Sinking Fund Categories
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sinking fund budget for [month] at [new output path]. Include annual bills and repairs, and explain how to enter monthly amounts.

prompt_templates.title: Include Side Hustle Income
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a side hustle workbook for [month] at [new output path]. Identify income and expense rows, and explain why totals are not profit.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: organize personal and side hustle categories.

prompt_templates.title: Build and Check a Combined Workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a combined budget for [month] at [new output path]. Confirm the destination is unused, then check both tabs and formula ranges.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine categories and verify the generated workbook.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly budget workbook for November 2026.
output: An XLSX workbook contains Budget and READ ME tabs.
Budget rows include Income, Housing, Utilities, Food, Transport, Health, Debt, Savings, Personal, and Other.
Planned and Actual cells start at zero; Remaining equals Planned minus Actual.

output_examples.input: Create a combined workbook for household spending, sinking funds, and my side hustle.
output: The Budget tab includes the standard household categories.
Additional rows cover annual bills, repairs, side hustle income, and side hustle expenses.
Column totals sum all categories and do not represent net income.
The READ ME tab explains inputs and monthly sinking fund estimates.

best_practices: Choose an unused output filename or back up the existing workbook before generation.
Enter amounts in the blue Planned and Actual cells, and preserve the formula cells.
Open the workbook in a spreadsheet application and verify calculations before using the figures.
anti_patterns: Treating summed income and expense categories as profit or disposable income.
Expecting automated bank synchronization, transaction classification, or tax advice.
Regenerating a workbook at an existing path without backing up manually entered amounts.

faq.question: Does this skill upload my budget?
faq.answer: The included script writes the workbook locally and contains no network requests. The documentation includes optional links to the template provider.

faq.question: What software does generation require?
faq.answer: Generation requires Python 3 and its standard library. Use a compatible spreadsheet application to enter amounts and calculate formulas.

faq.question: Which workbook types are available?
faq.answer: The script supports monthly, sinking, side-hustle, and combined modes. Each produces a Budget tab and a READ ME tab.

faq.question: Can I choose the month and destination?
faq.answer: Yes. Command line options accept a month label and workbook type, while a positional argument specifies the output path.

faq.question: Does the workbook calculate net income?
faq.answer: No. It calculates planned minus actual for each category and sums columns, including both income and expense rows.

faq.question: Will generation preserve an existing workbook?
faq.answer: No. The script replaces an existing file at the selected destination. Choose a new filename to preserve previous entries.
